# LaTeX `\rowcolor` Command

`\rowcolor` is used to color entire rows in tables. It's part of the **`xcolor`** package with the `table` option.

## Basic Usage

```latex
\usepackage[table]{xcolor}

\begin{tabular}{|c|c|c|}
\hline
\rowcolor{gray!30}
Header 1 & Header 2 & Header 3 \\
\hline
Row 1 & Data & Data \\
\rowcolor{blue!20}
Row 2 & Data & Data \\
\hline
\end{tabular}
```

## Common Examples

### Single colored row
```latex
\rowcolor{yellow}
Cell 1 & Cell 2 & Cell 3 \\
```

### Alternating row colors
```latex
\usepackage[table]{xcolor}

\begin{tabular}{ccc}
\rowcolor{gray!20} Row 1 & Data & Data \\
\rowcolor{white} Row 2 & Data & Data \\
\rowcolor{gray!20} Row 3 & Data & Data \\
\end{tabular}
```

### With `booktabs`
```latex
\usepackage{booktabs}
\usepackage[table]{xcolor}

\begin{tabular}{ccc}
\toprule
\rowcolor{gray!40}
Header & Header & Header \\
\midrule
Data & Data & Data \\
\bottomrule
\end{tabular}
```

## Color Specifications

```latex
\rowcolor{red}           % Named color
\rowcolor{red!50}        % 50% intensity
\rowcolor{red!30!blue}   % Mix colors
\rowcolor[gray]{0.8}     % Grayscale (0-1)
\rowcolor[rgb]{1,0,0}    % RGB values
```

## Important Notes

- Load `xcolor` with `[table]` option
- Place `\rowcolor` at the **beginning** of the row
- Works with standard `tabular`, `array`, and `tabulary` environments
